items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So I did the notes for the second one. ... Then I did an interview with Dylan for the New Yorker. Then we did our famous, or infamous, Playboy interview

ctx.x: You also interviewed – you also did a big profile on John Lindsey, among others, and Lennie – a very early one – which I was shocked. I’d never read – your early one on Bob Dylan.
Which is ’64, right? That’s very early.
